title: 13. Kolloquium Mobilhydraulik : Karlsruhe, 8./9. Oktober 2024
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: The manuscript “13th Mobile hydraulic colloquium” contains the collected contributions to the presentations of the event of the same name, which took place on the 8th/9th October 2024 in Karlsruhe. In nine articles the research state and new developments in the field of mobile hydraulics are reported.
